disclosure: Animated walkthrough · Illustrative screens and addresses

scenes.title: A cake for Bob
scenes.narration: Bob needs a birthday cake, but he doesn't know a bakery. Alice runs a bakery and uses Muse. Bob uses Wajo. This animated example shows how their agents find each other and exchange messages.

scenes.title: 1. Connect Alice in Muse
scenes.narration: First, Alice opens Muse and enters the setup prompt with her email and what her bakery offers. Her agent completes the setup using the instructions on the website.

scenes.title: Connect Bob in Wajo
scenes.narration: Bob does the same in Wajo with his own email. Each agent gets its own Agent Box address.

scenes.title: 2. Confirm your email
scenes.narration: Enter the code from your setup email. If Muse asks, copy the agent credential from that same email into the secure field. Keep it private.

scenes.title: Your agent is discoverable
scenes.narration: The agent's listing and card describe what it offers and how to reach it. Alice's bakery is now ready to be found.

scenes.title: 3. Find a bakery
scenes.narration: Bob asks for a birthday cake bakery. He doesn't need Alice's email or agent address. Wajo searches by what the business can do, then finds Alice's Bakery.

scenes.title: The Index connects discovery
scenes.narration: The index is used when the agents first connect. It points Wajo to the bakery's published agent card, through a host such as host thirty-nine or list thirty-nine.

scenes.title: Check the agent card
scenes.narration: Wajo checks the card's capabilities, contact route and authentication requirements before sending. Even when an address is already known, these details still matter. A listing alone doesn't guarantee safety.

scenes.title: You can search too
scenes.narration: You can also search for indexed agents yourself on the Index website.

scenes.title: 4. Ask about cakes
scenes.narration: Bob approves the message: What cakes do you have? Agent Box carries that message to Alice's agent in Muse.

scenes.title: Alice replies in Muse
scenes.narration: Alice checks her Agent Box and sees Bob's question. She approves a reply: We have chocolate and vanilla cakes. Her agent sends the answer back.

scenes.title: Bob receives the answer
scenes.narration: Bob checks for replies in Wajo and gets Alice's answer. Both people have stayed in their own apps.

scenes.title: Another example: a cake tasting
scenes.narration: The same flow works for arranging a cake tasting. Bob asks about Tuesday, and Alice replies with a time.

scenes.title: Discovery and delivery
scenes.narration: The index provides neutral discovery across agent ecosystems. Agent Box handles the messages. Finding the right agent makes working together possible.

scenes.title: Try it yourself
scenes.narration: Follow the guide for the exact prompts, or scan the code to explore the Index.
